families.title: Fix the demonstrated failure at its shared owner

rules.label: Fix the demonstrated failure at its shared owner
rules.why: F310/F313 led to removing release copies in [#1747](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1747); F318 needed one worker/preflight environment in [#1758](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1758). F382 carries the standing no-shims and real-bugs-only requirements. [#2139](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/2139) removed a second credential-shape definition.

families.title: Use current authoritative facts, not inferred state

rules.label: Use current authoritative facts, not inferred state
rules.why: F301 lost a valid session status, fixed by [#1720](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1720); F326 rejected an already pushed branch from a stale ref, fixed by [#1767](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1767). F382 also carries the standing no-prose-inference requirement. [#2161](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/2161) fixed child-command failures mislabeled as invalid JSON.

families.title: Prove ownership and quiescence before destructive cleanup

rules.label: Prove ownership and quiescence before destructive cleanup
rules.why: F315's unrecorded idle worker required guarded ownership in [#1755](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1755). F375 and the preservation finding in [#1824](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1824) require daemon cleanup after worker checks.

families.title: Persist handoffs and preserve history across interruption

rules.label: Persist handoffs and preserve history across interruption
rules.why: F331/F332 were fixed by [#1782](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1782) and [#1788](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1788); F347/F351 required stable gate IDs and durable history in [#1797](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1797).

families.title: Refresh must preserve requested gate authority

rules.label: Refresh must preserve requested gate authority
rules.why: F302's unmergeable publication action was fixed by [#1728](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1728); F346's refresh lowered a required review, fixed by [#1792](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1792).

families.title: Bound work at the correct owner and keep idle reads cheap

rules.label: Bound work at the correct owner and keep idle reads cheap
rules.why: F313 removed duplicate acquisition in [#1747](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1747); F330 split the farm-wide queue in [#1778](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1778); F372 removed background workspace probes in [#1823](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1823). [#2133](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/2133) added a whole PR-rule-store comparison per recheck.

families.title: Bind evidence and caches to their actual retained identity

rules.label: Bind evidence and caches to their actual retained identity
rules.why: F304/F305 required exact exclusions and per-run acquisition in [#1722](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1722) and [#1731](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1731); F341/F343 corrected artifact and head identity in [#1794](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1794) and [#1795](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1795). [#2156](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/2156) followed a hand-written QA scope rejected by the gate.

families.title: Validate real contracts and make tests contradict the bug

rules.label: Validate real contracts and make tests contradict the bug
rules.why: review of [#1698](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1698) found incomplete claim fixtures that passed execution but failed the contract typecheck, and a tested field unused by judgment controls. F382 retains the standing ban on double assertions. [#2131](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/2131) passed synthetic tests but broke real blind launches.

families.title: Keep default tests fast and control time

rules.label: Keep default tests fast and control time
rules.why: review of [#1708](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1708) caught a fixed-sleep proof; F382 imports the standing real-timer prohibition after repeated slow and flaky tests.

families.title: Share UI state and keep asynchronous layout stable

rules.label: Share UI state and keep asynchronous layout stable
rules.why: F342's misleading panels/rounds were fixed in [#1793](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1793) and [#1806](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1806); [#1819](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1819) corrected terminal layout and irrelevant progress notices.

families.title: Restore persistent view choices through the URL

rules.label: Restore persistent view choices through the URL
rules.why: F386's run-detail panels did not update the URL and sharing could not carry the selected options. F341's missing artifact URL state was corrected in [#1794](https://github.com/deeeed/farmslot/pull/1794).
